seal.statement: Dependency B for the raft-rs partition snapshot ownership work repairs only the existing per-replica lifecycle, durable-record and local-open storage interaction. Starting from exact clean 82b54ef9b7c8d6be9f2d6450cbc5e6713ade00af or its reviewed successor at seal time, opening a local raft-rs partition replica consumes target-local durable facts from their owners: peer identity and reservations, lifecycle/incarnation, durable record, HardState term/vote, log, snapshot/applied state, ConfState and membership generation. Virgin storage can initialize through the ordinary owner path; intact coherent storage opens without needing a fresh majority proof; legal vote 0 and coherent local lag are valid. Missing, unreadable, corrupt, noncanonical or internally contradictory local facts refuse before unsafe participation, or return a typed owner failure, without fabricating absence, HOLD, install authority, campaign, vote or a second ACTIVE lifecycle row. A readable current database with authoritative prior existence but absent durable raft record is KNOWN_WIPE and produces the existing reseed-required HOLD before native core entry; same-byte restart repeats the refusal and preserves the exact HOLD identity. Read-unavailable is distinct from missing/corrupt facts and blocks only the transition whose fact owner is unavailable. Three intact voters can cold restart from their own durable files without a pre-existing live leader, elect and commit an ordinary entry. This Quest does not create snapshot images, publish native snapshots, stage or install an accepted image, assert any accepted-image transaction, add a majority token, reconstruct a wiped voter as the same identity, use a late pre-create_node observer mutation as a CAS oracle, change FreshMG, or claim the final R1-R7 catch-up interaction.
